items.title_en: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
items.title_zh: 民主黨正式提名哈基姆·傑弗里斯為眾議院議長候選人
items.summary_en: House Democrats voted to support Hakeem Jeffries. He is now closer to becoming the first Black speaker of the House. This is a big step in U.S. history.
items.summary_zh: 眾議院民主黨人投票支持哈基姆·傑弗里斯。他現在距離成為美國史上首位黑人眾議院議長更近了一步。這是美國歷史上重要的一步。
items.why_important_en: It shows a major change in American political leadership.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了美國政治領導層的重大變革。

vocab.definition_en: To officially suggest someone for a job or position.
vocab.sentence_en: They decided to nominate her for the manager position.
vocab.sentence_zh: 他們決定提名她擔任經理職位。

vocab.definition_en: To agree with someone or something and show it.
vocab.sentence_en: I support your decision to change your career path.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我支持你轉換職涯跑道的決定。

items.title_en: Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres
items.title_zh: 緬甸因羅興亞人大屠殺面臨聯合國法院歷史性種族滅絕判決
items.summary_en: Myanmar is facing a court case about genocide. No country has ever been found guilty of this by an international court before. This is a very important legal case.
items.summary_zh: 緬甸正面臨一場關於種族滅絕的訴訟。過去從未有國家被國際法院判定犯下此罪。這是一起非常重要的法律案件。
items.why_important_en: It is a rare legal challenge against a country for serious human rights crimes.
items.why_important_zh: 這是針對國家嚴重人權罪行的一項罕見法律挑戰。

vocab.definition_en: Having done something wrong or broken the law.
vocab.sentence_en: The jury found him guilty of the crime.
vocab.sentence_zh: 陪審團判定他犯下該罪行。

vocab.definition_en: A place where legal cases are decided by a judge.
vocab.sentence_en: I have to go to court next week for jury duty.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我下週必須去法庭履行陪審員義務。

items.title_en: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
items.title_zh: 以色列軍隊在加薩發動罕見的「黃線」外地面行動
items.summary_en: The Israeli military started a ground operation in Gaza. They say they are destroying a tunnel. Hamas says this breaks the ceasefire agreement.
items.summary_zh: 以色列軍隊在加薩發動了地面行動。他們表示正在摧毀一條地道。哈馬斯則稱此舉違反了停火協議。
items.why_important_en: It increases tension in a conflict zone and breaks a ceasefire.
items.why_important_zh: 這加劇了衝突地區的緊張局勢並破壞了停火。

vocab.definition_en: To start an activity or an operation.
vocab.sentence_en: The company will launch a new product next month.
vocab.sentence_zh: 公司下個月將推出一項新產品。

vocab.definition_en: An action that breaks a rule or agreement.
vocab.sentence_en: Parking here is a violation of the building rules.
vocab.sentence_zh: 停在這裡違反了大樓規定。

items.title_en: Crimea bridge has been attacked again, says Russian-installed governor
items.title_zh: 俄羅斯任命的州長稱克里米亞大橋再次遇襲
items.summary_en: The bridge connecting Crimea to Russia was attacked again. Traffic is stopped while officials check the damage. This happened just two days after a previous attack.
items.summary_zh: 連接克里米亞與俄羅斯的大橋再次遭到攻擊。在官員檢查損壞情況時，交通已暫停。這距離上次攻擊僅過了兩天。
items.why_important_en: It affects transport and shows the ongoing conflict in the region.
items.why_important_zh: 這影響了交通運輸，並顯示了該地區持續進行的衝突。

vocab.sentence_en: The storm caused a lot of damage to the roof.
vocab.sentence_zh: 暴風雨對屋頂造成了嚴重損害。

vocab.sentence_en: The store is temporarily closed for renovations.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這家店為了裝修暫時關閉。

items.title_en: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
items.title_zh: 瑪麗·佩爾托拉翻轉阿拉斯加參議院席位；輝達不會讓黃仁勳回任
items.summary_en: Mary Peltola won a Senate race in Alaska. Also, Nvidia said they will not bring back their former CEO, Jensen Huang.
items.summary_zh: 瑪麗·佩爾托拉贏得了阿拉斯加的參議院選舉。此外，輝達表示不會讓前執行長黃仁勳回任。
items.why_important_en: These are significant updates in both American politics and the tech industry.
items.why_important_zh: 這些是美國政治與科技產業的重要更新。

vocab.definition_en: A competition to win a position or election.
vocab.sentence_en: She is preparing for the upcoming marathon race.
vocab.sentence_zh: 她正在為即將到來的馬拉松比賽做準備。

vocab.definition_en: The feeling of being forced to do something.
vocab.sentence_en: I feel a lot of pressure at work this week.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我這週在工作上感到很大壓力。
